notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork4_blender_mesh_batch3_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: AverageUvIslandScales. Oracle: a 2 x 2 island (3D area 4) and a 1 x 1 island (area 1) with unit-square UVs end with UV area per 3D area equal to the total UV area 2 over total 3D area 5, i.e. areas 1.6 and 0.4, each scaled uniformly about its own centre, total UV area unchanged; documentation: Blender Manual, docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/modeling/meshes/uv/editing.html (page 'Average Islands Scale'; definition paraphrased: averages the size of separate UV islands based on their area in 3D space); the manual page could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased and the sentence is not quoted; any Blender behaviour named below as recalled is 'recalled, needs owner check' and is not part of the independent oracle; python API: https://docs.blender.org/api/current/; Tested: equal density and uniform scaling about each island's centre. Untested: the common density Blender chooses (here total UV area over total 3D area, so the total UV area stays; recalled: needs owner check), the Scale U/V and Shear options, selection-only operation, and islands defined by UV connectivity (here by shared vertices). Untested: selection-only operation, UV sync selection, UDIM tiles, the single undo step and comparison against Blender's own UV output.

notes: covered by dino8-kernel/tests/extra/rowwork4_blender_mesh_batch3_oracles.cpp; closed-form/oracle: ComputeLscmUVs. Oracle: a half cylinder wall of radius 3, height 5 (6 steps, 14 vertices, 6 quads) is developable, so its unwrap is an isometry up to one global factor: every edge's UV length over 3D length is the same (spread under 0.1 percent); the 6 bottom vertices are collinear and the run over a vertical edge is 6 * 2 * 3 sin(pi/12) / 5 = 1.8635; documentation: Blender Manual, docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/modeling/meshes/uv/unwrapping/ (page 'Unwrap'; definition paraphrased: Angle Based and Conformal methods flatten a seam-cut surface to the UV plane); the manual page could not be fetched from this sandbox (network policy), so the definition is paraphrased and the sentence is not quoted; any Blender behaviour named below as recalled is 'recalled, needs owner check' and is not part of the independent oracle; python API: https://docs.blender.org/api/current/; Tested: the conformal (least squares) method on a developable open strip. Untested: Angle Based (ABF) method, Fill Holes, Correct Aspect, Use Subdivision Surface, seam cutting of closed meshes, margin and packing, the scale Blender applies to the result. Untested: selection-only operation, UV sync selection, UDIM tiles, the single undo step and comparison against Blender's own UV output.
